data.title: Ocean Pearl
data.about:
Samana Ocean Pearl 2 at Dubai Islands is the new phase of the premium waterfront development by Samana Developers, offering luxurious 100 units including 1, 2, 3, and 4-bedroom apartments with private pools. Ideally located in one of Dubai’s most sought-after communities, this low-rise, six-story architectural marvel provides residents with direct access to pristine beaches and breathtaking ocean views. The strategic location ensures seamless connectivity to major business districts and world-class shopping destinations while offering a tranquil retreat from the city's hustle.

Designed to redefine waterfront luxury, Samana Ocean Pearl at Dubai Islands blends contemporary elegance with nature’s serenity. Its sleek, modern façade complements the island’s natural beauty, offering expansive balconies with shimmering water views. Indulge in world-class leisure and wellness amenities, including a grand pool with a luxury deck, outdoor cinema, kids’ play area, state-of-the-art fitness center with Technogym equipment, steam and sauna rooms, BBQ areas, and lush green landscapes, ensuring a perfect balance of relaxation and recreation.

characteristics_module.title: Enjoy a Waterfront Lifestyle at Samana Ocean Pearl by Samana Developers
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Exclusive Waterfront Living: Located on the prestigious Dubai Islands, offering breathtaking sea views and direct beach access.
  • Private Pools in Every Unit: Each 1, 2, 3, and 4-bedroom apartment features a private pool, ensuring ultimate luxury and privacy.
  • Premium Quality Interiors: European solid core doors, Spanish porcelain tiles, and German matte black fixtures provide a sophisticated and elegant living space.
  • World-Class Amenities: Includes a grand swimming pool, outdoor cinema, kid's play area, state-of-the-art gym, steam & sauna rooms, BBQ areas, and lush landscaped gardens.
  • Limited-Edition Residences: Only 100 exclusive units are available, making it a rare and premium investment opportunity.
  • Seamless Connectivity: Just minutes away from key destinations such as Dubai Canal, Dubai Creek, Port Rashid, and Dubai International Airport.
  • Flexible Payment Plan: Attractive 40/60 plan with 20% down payment, 10% installments over 24 months, and 60% post-handover over 30 months (2% monthly).

location_tile.title: Discover a Vibrant Island Lifestyle at Dubai Islands
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Strategically located on Dubai Islands, Samana Ocean Pearl offers residents a harmonious blend of tranquility and connectivity. Known for its stunning waterfront vistas and peaceful atmosphere, Dubai Islands provide an ideal setting for a luxurious lifestyle. Residents enjoy direct access to serene azure waters, offering a retreat from the urban hustle. Despite its calm environment, the development ensures easy access to Dubai's major business hubs, upscale shopping centers, and world-class dining venues, providing a balanced lifestyle of relaxation and convenience.

  • 05 Minutes to Dubai Canal
  • 10 Minutes to Port Rashid
  • 10 Minutes to Dubai Creek
  • 10 Minutes to Deira Corniche Area
  • 15 Minutes to JBR The Walk
  • 20 Minutes to Al Mamzar Beach Park
  • 25 Minutes to Dubai International Airport
  • 25 Minutes to Heritage Village
